description: order-platform side of the integration: OrderConfirmed carries reservationId; new order.shipped event published through the outbox on CONFIRMED -> SHIPPED; the inventory RestClient sends a client-credentials Bearer token (Spring Security OAuth2ClientHttpRequestInterceptor + OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager, registration 'inventory', client shopflow-service). Decision for the open point: no test bypass; only the story tests call the real client and they already start Keycloak, so they get real tokens via the Keycloak test configuration; other contexts mock StockReservations. Depends on FEAT-001 (realm role). Independent of FEAT-003/004 code-wise.
steps: events/OrderConfirmed.java: add component @Nullable String reservationId (optional field, old messages stay readable). OrderService.confirmPayment: pass order.getReservationId().

events/OrderShipped.java (new): @JsonTypeName("order.shipped") @JsonIgnoreProperties(ignoreUnknown = true) record OrderShipped(long orderId, String reservationId) implements Payload; key() returns String.valueOf(orderId). Add it to Payload's permits clause.

OrderService.updateStatus: when status == SHIPPED call this.events.add(new OrderShipped(id, order.getReservationId())); update the javadoc. events/LoggingNotificationSender: add the OrderShipped case (throws IllegalArgumentException like UnknownPayload; never reached). events/OrderEventHandler.handle: skip OrderShipped before the inbox mark with a debug log.

order-platform/pom.xml: add spring-boot-starter-security-oauth2-client. application.yaml: spring.security.oauth2.client.registration.inventory (provider inventory, client-id shopflow-service, client-secret ${SHOPFLOW_INVENTORY_CLIENT_SECRET:}, authorization-grant-type client_credentials) and provider.inventory.token-uri ${SHOPFLOW_TOKEN_URI:http://localhost:8180/realms/shopflow/protocol/openid-connect/token} (explicit token-uri so startup does not need Keycloak). application-dev.yaml: client-secret shopflow-service-secret, marked dev only. Update the shopflow.inventory.base-url comment (real service, WireMock optional).

inventory/InventoryClientConfig: add bean OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager (client-credentials provider, AuthorizedClientServiceOAuth2AuthorizedClientManager over Boot's ClientRegistrationRepository and OAuth2AuthorizedClientService) and add OAuth2ClientHttpRequestInterceptor for registration 'inventory' to the RestClient next to CorrelationIdInterceptor. Verify against the resolved Spring Security 7 API (look into the jar if a name differs). Make sure token-fetch failures end as InventoryUnavailableException in InventoryStockReservations (add the OAuth2AuthorizationException catch if needed) so a Keycloak outage behaves like an inventory outage (503 to the caller, background release retried).

Tests: KeycloakTestcontainersConfiguration add a DynamicPropertyRegistrar for spring.security.oauth2.client.provider.inventory.token-uri (keycloak auth server url + /realms/shopflow/protocol/openid-connect/token) and registration.inventory.client-secret (SERVICE_SECRET). InventoryStandInContainer: add requestsWithBearerToken() using WireMock /__admin/requests/count with a header matcher. Us02PlaceOrderStoryTest: assert the stand-in saw a Bearer token on the reservation call. Us08PayForOrderStoryTest (or a new Us12 story class extending StoryTestSupport, no extra context properties): pay then PATCH SHIPPED and assert the outbox row/event of type order.shipped carries the order's reservationId, and that the order.confirmed event JSON has reservationId. Cover OrderEventHandler skipping OrderShipped without an inbox row and without a notification. Run OrderPlatformApplicationTests to confirm an empty client secret does not break contexts outside dev.
acceptance_criteria: order.confirmed JSON written to outbox_events contains reservationId equal to the order's reservation id
PATCH /api/orders/{id}/status SHIPPED on a CONFIRMED order writes exactly one order.shipped outbox event with orderId and reservationId; a repeated PATCH SHIPPED writes none
Every request the real InventoryClient sends carries Authorization: Bearer <token> obtained by client credentials for shopflow-service, and the token is cached between calls
OrderEventHandler does not send a notification or write an inbox row for order.shipped
./mvnw -B -ntp -pl order-platform verify passes, with no change to the number of Keycloak Spring contexts
verification: ./mvnw -B -ntp -pl order-platform verify  (script + log under order-platform/target/; check surefire reports for the new tests and no new skips)
findings: Done as planned. ./mvnw -B -ntp -pl order-platform verify: 168 tests (164 + 4 new), 0 failures, 0 skips, BUILD SUCCESS in 2m13s (log order-platform/target/feat002.log). No new Spring contexts. Spring Security 7.1.2 API used: OAuth2ClientHttpRequestInterceptor(OAuth2AuthorizedClientManager) with setClientRegistrationIdResolver(request -> 'inventory') and setPrincipalResolver(request -> fixed AnonymousAuthenticationToken) so one token cache entry serves all threads (incl. background release without security context); manager = AuthorizedClientServiceOAuth2AuthorizedClientManager + clientCredentials provider. InventoryClientConfig.REGISTRATION_ID='inventory'. InventoryStockReservations catches OAuth2AuthorizationException (reserve and release) -> InventoryUnavailableException. Empty client secret outside dev does not break contexts. New tests: OrderEventHandlerTest (unit, shipped skipped: no inbox, no sender), Us02 inventoryIsCalledWithAToken (stand-in saw Bearer on every request; InventoryStandInContainer.requestsWithBearerToken() and allRequests()), Us08 confirmedEventHasReservationId and shippingPublishesOrderShipped (repeat PATCH writes no second event; queries outbox_events with cast(payload as jsonb) ->> 'type'). StoryTestSupport.orderIdOf knows OrderShipped. Deviation: the 'token cached between calls' criterion is not asserted by a test (no Keycloak request counter), it relies on the manager's standard cache. Notes for later steps: OrderConfirmed JSON now has reservationId (nullable); order.shipped JSON = {orderId, reservationId}; env vars SHOPFLOW_INVENTORY_CLIENT_SECRET and SHOPFLOW_TOKEN_URI; dev profile secret = shopflow-service-secret. Docs (README/NOTES) not touched here, left to FEAT-004.
